title: English Armada
summary: The English Wikipedia article "English Armada", at revision 1382095161, opens: "The English Armada, also known as the Counter Armada, the Drake–Norris Expedition, or the Portugal Expedition, was an attack fleet sent against Spain by Queen Elizabeth I of England that sailed on 28 April 1589 during the undeclared Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604) and the Eighty Years' War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q145934, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1589 fleet of warships sent to Spain by Queen Elizabeth I of England". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
